summary: Master KoboToolbox, ODK, and XLSForm for professional M&E. Learn advanced survey logic, server security, and real-time dashboards. Enroll now for expert-led tra
lede: Digital data collection in monitoring and evaluation uses mobile tools to design, deploy, and manage field surveys. The course is for professionals responsible for data collection, quality, and analysis in social impact, humanitarian, and development work. Learn to build XLSForms with advanced logic, configure GPS and media capture, manage data collection servers, and create dashboards for monitoring field data.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals who are responsible for the integrity, collection, and analysis of data within social impact, humanitarian, and development contexts.
audience: Information Management Officers (IMO) in humanitarian response
modules: Digital Data Ecosystems and MDC Foundations
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) principles and basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Prior experience with mobile data collection is beneficial but not required. Participants must bring a laptop with Excel installed and an Android mobile device for field testing exercises.
topics: Data collection, survey design & mobile tools
